# Contributing

Bug reports and pull requests are welcome.

* **Bugs.** Use the bug report template. For start problems, attach the log
  from "Copy log" on the start screen.
* **Security issues.** Report them privately: see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
* **A problem in one app that uses Shizuku.** This usually comes from that
  app. [docs/CLIENT_APPS.md](../docs/CLIENT_APPS.md) lists what changed on
  Android 17.

Before you open a pull request, run the checks from
[docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#checks), and keep each commit to
a single change. For the UI, use Material 3 roles and the text appearances in
`res/values/design_bugra.xml`, not hard-coded colors or fonts.
